name: nacos-ai-registry
description: Find reusable Skills, tools and specialist Agents in Nacos to help complete your task.

interface.longDescription: Find reusable Skills, MCP tools and specialist Agents in your Nacos AI Registry for identification and lookup, business data, team rules, and domain workflows or automation. Discover help while planning a task or when an initial attempt yields no useful result; ordinary requests need not mention Nacos. Includes an interactive resource center for managing and using resources. Requires Python 3.11+ and a local desktop executor; configure your registry connection after installation. Automatic discovery depends on the application exposing the guidance and the model selecting it.
defaultPrompt: 在本地 Codex 中初始化 Nacos AI Registry，先检查插件工具是否可用。
打开 Nacos 资源中心。
查找 Nacos 中可用的技能、MCP 工具和远端 Agent。
